confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge, not live listings. Restaurant and hostel anchors are moderately solid; hotel rates are least certain given wide beach-area price spreads and July low-season effects. Assumes about 33 THB per USD. Cocktail and wine set from beer-relative pricing (about 2.5 to 2.7 times beer) due to weaker direct knowledge. FX value came from web search summaries of the RBA table, not a direct page read; if the 15 Oct 4pm rate was not yet published, 14 Oct (0.7002) is the prior observation.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Thai beach and island tourism pricing, using Krabi and Koh Samui as informal comparables, with July low-season discounting applied to accommodation.
